Uniform logarithmic expansions show the paired random term first at order h³ and the iid term at order h². E[C]=1/6, Var(C)=1/180, Var(U)=1/12; bounded iid CLT and exponentiation give the exact reported Gaussian limits. value.rationale: The base randomized implicit RK2 method explicitly fails mean-square A-stability, a consequential stiff-integration limitation. Antithetic coupling is a natural method modification at identical evaluation cost that restores pathwise pairwise A-stability and provably suppresses finite-horizon stochastic variance by two powers of h, with exact nonzero limiting constants. This is a structural stability and random-error separation, not a cosmetic parameter substitution or arbitrary finite computation. It does not eliminate deterministic discretization bias.
